name: Can storm damage restoration increase my home's value?

mainEntity.name: Can storm damage restoration increase my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: While the primary goal of storm damage restoration is to return your home to its pre-damage condition, some repairs can inadvertently increase its value. If outdated components are replaced with newer, more energy-efficient, or higher-quality materials (e.g., impact-resistant roofing, modern windows), this can be seen as an upgrade. Additionally, addressing underlying issues like water intrusion or structural weaknesses during restoration can prevent future problems, contributing to long-term property value and appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, if restoration involves upgrading to newer, more efficient, or higher-quality materials, it can potentially increase your home's value beyond its pre-damage state.
